bio.text: James E. Clyburn represents South Carolina's 6th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives and first came to Congress in 1993.
He served as House Majority Whip from 2007 to 2010 and from 2019 to 2022, and as Assistant Democratic Leader from 2011 to 2018 and from 2023 to March 2024.
A native of Sumter, South Carolina, he graduated from South Carolina State in 1961 and began his career as a public-school teacher in Charleston.
He joined Gov. John C. West's staff in 1971 and was South Carolina Human Affairs Commissioner from 1974 until 1992.
